_comment: Shared pointers to the living coding-style docs in Notion. Written to by the coding-style skill, read by ticket-pipeline (and any other skill that wants style guidance) so the page is only hardcoded in one place.

rules_database.description: The Style Rules themselves, one row per rule. The row title is the binding rule as a terse imperative; the row's page body holds the reasoning, the boundaries and the exceptions. Columns: Category, Status (Active/Superseded), Hot list, Enforced by, Added. The guide page above keeps the intro, the hot list, and the Change Log.
